language.name: The Ledger Broadside
language.rationale: Rooted in investigative print journalism, this design language enforces uncompromising monochrome hierarchy, razor-sharp editorial geometry, and an editorial hairline rule to accommodate dense, descriptive panel roles with absolute clarity over live footage.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (balanced density - 25/33px padding, 11px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
